annotations.title: Domain intel: DNS, SPF/DMARC, RDAP, email-security grade

description: [PAID $0.003 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] One call domain lookup for agents: DNS records A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA (Cloudflare DoH), SPF parsed (all qualifier, lookup count, issues), DMARC parsed (policy, pct, rua, issues), RDAP summary (registrar, created, expires, updated, status, DNSSEC via rdap.org) and a 0-100 email-security score with letter grade and reasons. Param name = public domain (example.com; URLs are reduced to their host). IPs/internal names refused (400), NXDOMAIN 404, DNS upstream down 502: never charged.

name.description: Public domain name, e.g. example.com (no IPs, no internal TLDs). Optional: defaults to example.com.
